blockers.issue: The question images are not transcriptions, they are direct reproductions of the published book's printed pages, including the book's own case numbering, typography, printed question wording and printed arrow annotations. All 501 question images are of this kind. The repo carries no licence, no permission statement and no user-visible attribution to the source work anywhere. This is a rights question the owner must resolve before a public upload; I am reporting the facts, not giving a legal opinion.
